title: Fibonacci pivot formula substitution — Daily/H1 and Weekly/H4

dataset.analysis_timeframe: Daily Fibonacci pivots/H1 and Weekly Fibonacci pivots/H4

windows.protected_holdout: 2022-2025 already exposed for related Daily/H1 classic-pivot question; not used as pristine holdout here

hypotheses.market_question: Does replacing classic floor-pivot coordinates with standard Fibonacci pivot coordinates preserve or improve the successful Daily/H1 and Weekly/H4 pivot-zone wick/terminal relationships when response logic and zone geometry are held fixed?
hypotheses.null: Fibonacci pivot coordinates do not produce a robust positive structural terminal effect and pivot-specific wick interaction under the frozen Daily/H1 and Weekly/H4 designs.
hypotheses.alternative: At least one frozen Fibonacci pivot horizon preserves a robust positive structural and wick interaction, with paired formula comparison identifying whether Fibonacci improves, degrades or is equivalent to classic pivots.
hypotheses.mechanism: If the pivot phenomenon reflects range-proportional support/resistance geometry rather than the classic floor-pivot algebra specifically, Fibonacci-distributed levels may preserve or strengthen the local exhaustion relationship.

method.primary_endpoint: Daily/H1 Fibonacci wick interaction at 0-20% spacing core vs 30-50% outer; Weekly/H4 Fibonacci wick interaction at SP10 0-10% core vs 40-50% outer; structural core-minus-outer terminal effects are required companion endpoints.
method.economic_effect_size: Percentage-point terminal-hazard and pivot-specific wick-interaction effects, plus paired Fibonacci-minus-Classic effect differences by pair-year cluster.
method.event_definition: Standard Fibonacci pivots PP=(H+L+C)/3; R/S1=PP±0.382R, R/S2=PP±0.618R, R/S3=PP±1.0R. Terminal labels remain pivot-blind ATR24/0.75 with strictly later-bar confirmation; wick strong >=30%, weak <10%.

inference.multiple_testing: separate Holm correction across two Fibonacci structural hypotheses and two Fibonacci wick hypotheses

execution.same_bar_policy: candidate endpoint cannot self-confirm on same response candle

holdout.protected_window: 2022-2025 already exposed for related Daily/H1 classic-pivot question
holdout.prior_exposure: 2022-2025 was consumed for DFXC-20260808-003. This Fibonacci study uses 2015-2021 only and makes no pristine-holdout claim.

provenance.notes: Standard 0.382/0.618/1.000 Fibonacci levels frozen before any Fibonacci outcome computation. Zone geometry and response logic inherited unchanged from successful classic-pivot studies.
